spans.s:
Pacata, like Pakti, denotes ‘cooked food’ in the Rigveda^1
and later.^2
1) i. 61, 7; x. 116, 8.
2) Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā, xxi. 60;
xxiii. 13; Kauṣītaki Brāhmaṇa, viii. 21,
etc.

Pacana in the Rigveda^1 and the Śatapatha Brāhamaṇa^2
denotes a ‘vessel for cooking’ food.
1) i. 162, 6.
2) vi. 5, 43, 3. 4; xiv. 1, 2, 21.
